claims.claim: RoBERTa keeps a BERT-style encoder and MLM objective while changing data, masking, sentence-pair objective, batch and training duration.
RoBERTa dynamic and static masking results in Table 1 are 78.3/84.3/92.5 and 78.7/84.0/92.9 for SQuAD 2.0 F1, MNLI-m accuracy and SST-2 accuracy.
RoBERTa compares SEGMENT-PAIR+NSP, SENTENCE-PAIR+NSP, FULL-SENTENCES and DOC-SENTENCES.

claims.claim: RoBERTa pretraining data totals about 160GB from BooksCorpus/Wikipedia, CC-News, OpenWebText and Stories.
RoBERTa-Base uses peak learning rate 6e-4 and 24K warmup; RoBERTa-Large uses 4e-4 and 30K warmup; both use batch 8K and 500K steps.
claims.verification_note: Base and Large values are distinguished.

claims.claim: RoBERTa Table 4 reports development-set results, while GLUE leaderboard test results are separately presented in Table 5.
RoBERTa uses byte-level BPE with approximately 50K vocabulary rather than BERT's WordPiece tokenizer.
